title: provisioning settings
description: Operator settings for the provisioning module (company.yaml modules.provisioning). Credentials (the API token, the directory token, connector tokens and secrets) are never settings.

dry_run.description: Record every run and its plan but call no connector. On by default in the chart: turn it off only after reading docs/provisioning.md.

privileged_groups.description: SCIM group names whose members are privileged: granting them access, and removing their access on leaving, needs a second person (an approval).

delete_after_days.description: Delete a leaver's downstream accounts this many days after their last day (0 keeps them, disabled). Deleting always needs an approval.

timezone.description: IANA time zone in which a leaver's last day ends.
